description: 20-iteration deep-research study (gpt-5.6-sol high; synthesized by gpt-5.6-sol xhigh; verified by DeepSeek V4 Pro) of the graphene-main Rust event-sourced graph engine with a belief/truth-maintenance layer. Extends the repo-1 graph-based deep-loop design with executable contracts for truth-maintaining convergence, a ledger-to-graph fold reducer, adversarial causal-prefix parity, claim-and-fence mutation safety, serializable truth admission, authority-zero refusals, and belief-context human gates.
